item.title: 【Singles (lossless)】En Vogue - Hold On (Edited Version) US Promo CD PRCD 3386
item.description:
This is one of the 2 US Promo CDs (the other being a 3 track promo CD) released for En Vogue's debut single, Hold On. The single peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 & #1 on the US Hot R&B/Hip-Hop songs Chart (known as the Hot Black Singles chart then), in 1990. The Radio Edit (4:16), I believe (but I am not too sure), is only found on this promo CD.

Ripped from personal collection, hope you like it

Tracklist:

1. Hold On (Radio Edit) 4:16
2. Hold On (Edited Version) 4:21
